title: Canonical finite evaluation of integral scalar extension
statement: For a fixed mate record d, field stage E, level n, endpoint and reconstruction R, the finite scalar functor for the quotient at exponent n+1 is naturally isomorphic to R.equivalence.functor followed by R.evaluation n. Construct this isomorphism by lifting the scalar equality realization, the canonical finiteReductionIso, and the inverse reconstruction evaluation through the full finite inclusion. The inverse has exactly the homogeneous ambient normalization asserted in ReductionMates.

source.place: Construction 4.1, Lemma 5.22 and Proposition 5.26; normalized reduction and exceptional mate compatibility.

proof.text: Compose the scalar equality realization, the canonical comparison of finite derived tensors, and the inverse reconstruction evaluation. Lift the result with Mathlib Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight. The map-preimage identity and the inverse of a composite give the displayed normalization.
